card.name: Capital O starting Ov-/Os-/Op- words
card.fires_on: The capital letter O standing alone as the first piece of a split word, such as Ovaries, Osteogenic, Opioid or Ophthalmic. It often follows a number in a dosimetry table or a section number.

modes.label: Ovaries in dosimetry tables
modes.description: The letter O begins Ovaries right after a row of numbers in radiation dose tables.

modes.label: Opioid, Osteo-, Ophthalmic words
modes.description: The letter O begins a medical term such as opioid, osteonecrosis or ophthalmic, often after a section number or drug name.

card.plain: It fires on a lone capital O that starts a longer medical word like Ovaries, Opioid or Osteonecrosis.
